1339-2034-7824-7924.description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw two cards due to Bard.
The Locust God triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

728-2281-3175.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4681-5170-7918-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

206-1368-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
206-1368-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4068-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites:
You control four or more Squirrels.
You control at least one Mountain.
4068-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4068-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1170-2642-4050-7419.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Emeritus of Ideation // Ancestral Recall, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

206-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
206-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

372-1809-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

232-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1385-1497-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1939-2292-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 if Lunarch Veteran is on the battlefield.
1939-2292-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Viscera Seer enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1497-2018-4053.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
When Wild Cantor dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1542-3765-6102.manaNeeded: {5}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
1542-3765-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
1542-3765-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {5}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

2042-6185-6280.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in hand.
2042-6185-6280.description:
Activate Golgari Brownscale's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it, causing you to mill a number of cards and return Golgari Brownscale from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.

2816-3156-4763-5173.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Shambling Ghast.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, targeting Koll.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4659-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-5789.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

791-1605-3693-5426.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-1605-3693-5426.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

3244-4688-5171.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of permanent cards in your library equal to or greater than twenty minus the number of creatures you control.
3244-4688-5171.description:
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library, causing you to descend once for each permanent card put into your graveyard this way.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mycotyrant triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus creature tokens equal to the number of times you've descended this turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

409-4211-4872.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

3832-4949.notablePrerequisites: Puresight Merrow does not have summoning sickness.
3832-4949.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat.

1196-1651-3094-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1196-1651-3094-4659.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Gluntch triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Gluntch's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Gluntch trigger, causing an opponent to put two +1/+1 counters on a creature they control, then causing the opponent with the largest deck size to draw a card, then causing you to create two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2493-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Gilded Lotus.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
